name: linkding
notes: Log in as admin; the password is in /opt/linkding/.nova-secrets (SECRET1).
compose:
services:
  linkding:
    image: sissbruecker/linkding:latest
    container_name: linkding
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "{PORT}:9090"
    environment:
      LD_SUPERUSER_NAME: "admin"
      LD_SUPERUSER_PASSWORD: "{SECRET1}"
    volumes:
      - {DATA}/data:/etc/linkding/data
